@@U00961@@
What is this vision? What heavenly form do I see in this magic glass? O Love, Love, lend me your swiftest wings and guide me to her, lead me to her presence! Ah, if I move from this spot, if I dare to approach her by only a step, it’s as if I saw her only in a mist. How beautiful, how unspeakably beautiful! Can woman be so lovely? I see in this reclining figure the quintessence of all the heavens. Does earth have anything to show more fair?

@@U00963@@
Of course! When God slaves like a dog for six whole days and then on the seventh cries Bravo! there’s got to be something mighty clever there! But go on, don’t let me stop you, gaze away, look your fill for now. I know just how to hunt down such a darling for you. And happy the man lucky enough to lead her home as his bride! (浮士德 continues to look in the mirror, as 梅菲斯特 stretches out in the chair, plays with the whisk, and continues talking.) Here I sit like a king on his throne, scepter in hand, and all that’s lacking is a crown. (The MONKEYS, who have been performing all sorts of odd antics, bring a crown to 梅菲斯特 with a great outcry.)

@@U00965@@
Oh, be so good, sir,
translation:
@@U00961@@
这个愿景是什么？我在这块魔法玻璃中看到了什么天堂形态？噢，爱，爱，请借给我你最快的翅膀，引导我到她身边，引导我到她的面前！啊，如果我离开这里，只要我敢靠近她一步，就好像只在雾里看到她一样。多么美丽，多么难以言喻的美丽！女人可以这么可爱吗？我在这个斜躺的人物身上看到了诸天的精华。地球还有什么比这更公平的吗？

@@U00963@@
当然！当上帝像狗一样奴役了整整六天，然后在第七天大喊“太棒了！”那里一定有一些非常聪明的东西！但继续吧，别让我阻止你，把目光移开，暂时看个够。我知道如何为你追捕这样的宝贝。幸运的是，这个男人有幸带领她作为他的新娘回家！ （浮士德继续照镜子，而梅菲斯特则在椅子上伸了个懒腰，玩弄拂尘器，继续说话。）在这里，我像国王一样坐在王座上，手里拿着权杖，所缺的只是一顶王冠。 （猴子们一直在表演各种奇怪的滑稽动作，在强烈抗议中为梅菲斯特带来了皇冠。）

@@U00965@@
哦，你真好，先生，
